is: The library's flag cloth: how a flag's cloth waves in the air, the move `cloth` of the flag row kind (data/checks/row-kinds.json), made by the motion row (score/stages/motion/cloth.py) for every flag of a place whose site stands in air. One flag simulated once for every flag of the same model, each played from its own moment of that one run (`phases`), so a place's flags never wave in step. The cloth is the flag's parts whose library surface is made with a recipe the cloth table holds (data/physics/cloth.json: its density, stiffness and bending, each with its source); the pole is its other parts and holds the cloth's edge along its upright line. The wind blows the way the flag's own model streams, from its pole along its cloth to its free edge: a scene names no wind. Its mean speed is the middle of `wind` (Beaufort's light flag extended), its gusts the `turbulence` of a standard wind spectrum at the height of the cloth's middle over the flag's foot, its push the flat plate's normal pressure of `plate` in the air of the site's body (`air`, scaled by the body's own surface pressure). Limits, written down: the wind's speed is Beaufort's, given at 10 m, taken at the flag unslowed; the air is taken as Earth's mix at Earth's sea-level temperature on any body (only its pressure scales it); the cloth feels only the air's push across it (no skin friction along it) and never meets itself.

wind.from: the Beaufort scale, force 3 (gentle breeze): 3.4 to 5.4 m/s at 10 m, on land 'leaves and small twigs in constant motion; wind extends light flag' (WMO, Manual on Marine Meteorological Services, WMO-No. 558, and the US National Weather Service's Beaufort wind force scale)

turbulence.from: IEC 61400-1 ed. 3 (2005): the normal turbulence model's sigma_1 = I_ref (0.75 V + b), b 5.6 m/s, I_ref 0.16 (category A, 6.3.1.3); Annex B's Kaimal spectrum S_k(f) = 4 sigma_k^2 (L_k / V) / (1 + 6 f L_k / V)^(5/3), sigma_2 = 0.8 sigma_1, sigma_3 = 0.5 sigma_1, L_1 = 8.1, L_2 = 2.7 and L_3 = 0.66 times the scale parameter Lambda_1 = 0.7 z (z up to 60 m); along the wind, across it and up

air.unit: kilograms a cubic metre at kilopascals
air.from: the International Standard Atmosphere at sea level (ISO 2533:1975): 1.225 kg/m3 at 101.325 kPa and 15 C

plate.from: Hoerner, Fluid-Dynamic Drag (1965), chapter 3: a square flat plate standing across the flow, drag coefficient 1.17; taken as the coefficient of the pressure across each of the cloth's triangles, by the square of the wind's speed across it

make.why: the simulation's own settings, none a measure of the world: the cloth's grid every 2 cm, a joint of the rig every second node (4 cm), 20 substeps a frame and 10 VBD iterations (the people cloth's), 3 s let pass for the cloth to leave its built shape before the run is kept, its last second blended into its first so it loops, each flag played from a moment up to 5 s into the run, the wind's draw seeded once for the library
